blocks.alt: Ambush Outdoors Explorer Day House 14' x 6.5'

blocks.text:
Our Ambush aluminum house is 6.5' wide and 14' long, with 8 holes.​​​  The heat will be on and the holes will be drilled when you arrive.  The house is located on Little Detroit Lake.  With 2 spacious padded benches, this house comfortably fits 6 people, with a 8 person maximum, and it's available 7 days a week.  The bench seats even fold down into a bed so you can take it easy while you fish!  There is 12v lighting, plug ins, and two fans.  


​


What's more the house still has the perfect layout to support live imaging.  Want to try out live imaging?  You're in luck, Baxstar offers the only live Imaging rental in Minnesota.  To rent Live Imaging, choose "1" from the dropdown menu, at the top of the booking page.


​​​​​​​​


​​
